import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int N_MAX = 7;

    static class ModInt {
        int val;

        ModInt(long v) {
            v %= MOD;
            if (v < 0)
                v += MOD;
            val = (int) v;
        }

        static int modInv(int a, int m) {
            long m0 = m, t, q;
            long x0 = 0, x1 = 1;
            while (a > 1) {
                q = a / m;
                t = m;
                m = (int)(a % m);
                a = (int)t;
                t = x0;
                x0 = x1 - q * x0;
                x1 = t;
            }
            if (x1 < 0)
                x1 += m0;
            return (int) x1;
        }

        ModInt plus(ModInt other) {
            int res = val + other.val;
            if (res >= MOD) res -= MOD;
            return new ModInt(res);
        }

        ModInt minus(ModInt other) {
            int res = val - other.val;
            if (res < 0) res += MOD;
            return new ModInt(res);
        }

        static long fastMod(long x, int m) {
            return x % m;
        }

        ModInt times(ModInt other) {
            long res = fastMod((long) val * other.val, MOD);
            return new ModInt(res);
        }

        ModInt div(ModInt other) {
            return this.times(new ModInt(modInv(other.val, MOD)));
        }

        ModInt pow(long p) {
            assert p >= 0;
            ModInt base = this;
            ModInt result = new ModInt(1);
            while (p > 0) {
                if ((p & 1) == 1)
                    result = result.times(base);
                base = base.times(base);
                p >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }

        ModInt inv() {
            return new ModInt(modInv(val, MOD));
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (!(o instanceof ModInt)) return false;
            ModInt modInt = (ModInt) o;
            return val == modInt.val;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(val);
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return Integer.toString(val);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        int N = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        ModInt[][] probability = new ModInt[N][N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                int p = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                probability[i][j] = new ModInt(p).div(new ModInt(100));
            }
        }

        List<List<Integer>> masksWithCount = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= N_MAX; i++) {
            masksWithCount.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }

        int[] lookup = new int[1 << N];
        Arrays.fill(lookup, -1);

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); mask++) {
            int count = Integer.bitCount(mask);
            lookup[mask] = masksWithCount.get(count).size();
            masksWithCount.get(count).add(mask);
        }

        Map<Long, ModInt> possibleMasks = new HashMap<>();
        possibleMasks.put(1L << lookup[0], new ModInt(1));

        for (int left = 0; left < N; left++) {
            Map<Long, ModInt> newPossibleMasks = new HashMap<>();
            for (int current = 0; current < (1 << N); current++) {
                ModInt product = new ModInt(1);
                for (int right = 0; right < N; right++) {
                    boolean bitSet = ((current >> right) & 1) != 0;
                    if (bitSet)
                        product = product.times(probability[left][right]);
                    else
                        product = product.times(new ModInt(1).minus(probability[left][right]));
                }

                for (Map.Entry<Long, ModInt> p : possibleMasks.entrySet()) {
                    long possible = p.getKey();
                    ModInt prob = p.getValue();

                    long new_possible = 0;
                    for (int mask : masksWithCount.get(left)) {
                        if (((possible >> lookup[mask]) & 1) != 0) {
                            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                                boolean bitCurrent = ((current >> i) & 1) != 0;
                                boolean bitMask = ((mask >> i) & 1) != 0;
                                if (bitCurrent && !bitMask) {
                                    long newMask = mask | (1L << i);
                                    new_possible |= 1L << lookup[(int)newMask];
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    newPossibleMasks.put(new_possible, newPossibleMasks.getOrDefault(new_possible, new ModInt(0)).plus(prob.times(product)));
                }
            }
            possibleMasks = newPossibleMasks;
        }

        ModInt answer = new ModInt(0);
        long fullMaskKey = 1L << lookup[(1 << N) - 1];
        for (Map.Entry<Long, ModInt> p : possibleMasks.entrySet()) {
            long key = p.getKey();
            if (((key >> lookup[(1 << N) - 1]) & 1) != 0) {
                answer = answer.plus(p.getValue());
            }
        }
        System.out.println(answer.val);
    }
}
